turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail: Kai moves quickly to process and ship it, so changes to the shipping method aren't possible after fulfillment. If your order hasn't shipped yet, you may be able to upgrade the shipping method by calling OluKai at +1 877-789-5131 for the fastest response.If you need your item sooner and your order has already shipped, the best option is to place a new order with expedited shipping and return the original order once it arrives. Let me know if you'd like help checking your order status or tracking!
